buildSystem.workspaceModel: bnd workspace: cnf/ config project, settings.gradle applies biz.aQute.bnd.workspace, project set seeded by bnd_build=osgi.build

coordinates.versionScheme: osgi.version + yyyyMMddHHmm build timestamp; -snapshot property switches snapshot/RC/release

directoryTopology.org.osgi.service.*: 50 specification API projects (one package per service spec)
directoryTopology.org.osgi.test.support | org.osgi.test.fi: shared TCK support library (OSGiTestCase, DefaultTestBundleControl, collectors, sleep, signature)
directoryTopology.org.osgi.util.*: 6 utility API projects: converter, function, promise, pushstream, tracker, xml
directoryTopology.osgi.*: 9 aggregate/packaging projects: osgi.core, osgi.cmpn, osgi.annotation, osgi.promise, osgi.companion, osgi.specs (docbook spec sources), osgi.tck (TCK packaging), osgi.impl (RI packaging), osgi.build (build seed + workspace plugins)
directoryTopology.infrastructure: cnf/ (workspace config + includes/*.bnd), licensed/ (prebuilt licensed binary repo), templates/, xmlns/, json.schema/, dmforest/, .design/, gradle/

entryPoints: ./gradlew :build :publish — builds and releases artifacts into cnf/generated/repo (CONTRIBUTING.md L23)

testLayout.model: TCK projects run inside a real OSGi framework: -runfw org.osgi.impl.framework (cnf/build.bnd L113), -runbundles list impl under test
testLayout.support: tests extend org.osgi.test.support.OSGiTestCase (JUnit 3 TestCase with injected BundleContext) or DefaultTestBundleControl
testLayout.testBundles: inner test bundles (tb1.jar, tb2.jar) generated by -make from bnd/tbN.bnd recipes, embedded via -includeresource
testLayout.signatureTests: -signaturetest <package> verifies API signatures via SignatureTest workspace plugin
testLayout.secureVariants: *.secure sibling projects rerun suites with Java security enabled (runsecureproperties, cnf/build.bnd)

ci.pages: CI publishes draft Core + Compendium specs to gh-pages (README.md)

license: Apache-2.0 (LICENSE; SPDX headers in every file)

surpriseEdges: MyGenericDTOWithVariables --inherits--> DTO (converter TCK depends on org.osgi.dto)
GenericFieldDto --inherits--> DTO (converter TCK depends on org.osgi.dto)
TbExtension --references--> Capability (cdi.secure TCK uses bundle annotations)
